rules.description: 月度客户联系目标请求（request.monthly-customer-contact）与电话销售绩效协议 （contract.sales-performance）匹配，并且目标周期内匹配的客户联系记录 （confirmation.customer-contact-record）总数、电话数和邮件数分别达到本次约定目标时， 判定月度客户联系目标履约（fulfillment.monthly-customer-contact）完成。
rules.expression:
request.agreement_id == agreement.agreement_id &&
request.target_contact_count >= 0 && request.target_phone_count >= 0 &&
request.target_email_count >= 0 &&
records.filter(r, r.request_id == request.request_id &&
r.agreement_id == request.agreement_id && r.period_id == request.period_id &&
r.confirmed_at >= request.started_at &&
r.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at &&
(r.channel == "phone" || r.channel == "email")).size() >=
request.target_contact_count &&
records.filter(r, r.request_id == request.request_id &&
r.agreement_id == request.agreement_id && r.period_id == request.period_id &&
r.confirmed_at >= request.started_at &&
r.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at &&
r.channel == "phone").size() >= request.target_phone_count &&
records.filter(r, r.request_id == request.request_id &&
r.agreement_id == request.agreement_id && r.period_id == request.period_id &&
r.confirmed_at >= request.started_at &&
r.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at &&
r.channel == "email").size() >= request.target_email_count
rules.label: 月度客户联系目标已完成
